# Brand CGP — template

Fill one per brand and paste it into Postaja (Brand → CGP). Write it in any language;
the output language is set per channel. Be concrete — examples beat adjectives.
Sections marked (machine) are also entered as structured rules so Postaja can check them automatically.

---

## 1. Who we are
- Brand name:
- Website:
- One sentence: what we do and for whom.
- What makes us different (2–3 points):

## 2. Audience
- Who they are (role, age range, situation):
- What they want:
- What frustrates them:
- What they already know / don't know (level of expertise):

## 3. Offer and goal of social posts
- What we sell / promote (product, course, service, personal brand):
- Main goal of posts (awareness, followers, leads, sales, authority):
- Default CTA (e.g. "link in bio", "comment KEYWORD", "follow for more"):

## 4. Voice
- Tone in 3 words (e.g. direct, warm, nerdy):
- Formal or informal address (e.g. "ti" / "vi"):
- We sound like: (a person, a creator, a magazine)
- We never sound like:
- Phrases we like:
- Phrases we never use:

## 5. Content pillars
| Pillar | Description | Target share % |
|---|---|---|
| | | |
| | | |
| | | |

## 6. Rules (machine where possible)
- Banned words (machine):
- Emojis: none / max N / allowed (machine: max count)
- Hashtags: max N, always include: (machine)
- Max length per channel (machine):
- Must end with CTA: yes / no (machine)
- Links: in caption / first comment / never
- Facts and claims: what we may never promise or claim:
- Other hard rules:

## 7. Visual identity
- Colors (hex): primary, secondary, background, text, accent
- Fonts: headline, body (upload files; must include č š ž ć đ)
- Logo: where it appears (corner of slides, last slide only, never)
- Image style (prompt prefix): e.g. "editorial photo, natural light, muted colors, 35mm"
- Avoid in images (negative prompt):
- Carousel look: minimal text on solid color / text over photo / illustrated

## 8. Examples
Paste 3–10 posts that are exactly how we want to sound (and why each one is good).

---

## Persona DNA (only for AI influencer brands)

- Name / handle:
- Age (apparent):
- Face: shape, eyes (color, shape), eyebrows, nose, lips, distinctive marks
- Hair: color, length, texture, usual styles
- Skin: tone, freckles, etc.
- Body: height impression, build
- Signature style: outfits, colors, accessories, makeup
- Typical locations / settings:
- Personality: 3–5 traits, how she talks, humour
- Voice (for video): pitch, pace, accent, language
- Never: (poses, outfits, topics, settings)
- Passport images: 3–10 consistent images (front, 3/4, profile, smiling, neutral); mark one as primary.
